def print_diamond_pattern(n):
    # Upper half of the diamond
    for i in range(n + 1):
        # Print spaces
        for j in range(n - i):
            print(" ", end=" ")

        # Print ascending numbers
        for j in range(i + 1):
            print(j, end=" ")

        # Print descending numbers
        for j in range(i - 1, -1, -1):
            print(j, end=" ")

        # Move to the next line
        print()

    # Lower half of the diamond
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        # Print spaces
        for j in range(n - i):
            print(" ", end=" ")

        # Print ascending numbers
        for j in range(i + 1):
            print(j, end=" ")

        # Print descending numbers
        for j in range(i - 1, -1, -1):
            print(j, end=" ")

        # Move to the next line
        print()

def generate_handkerchief(n):
    rows = []
    
    # Generate the upper half of the handkerchief
    for i in range(n + 1):
        row = ' ' * (2 * (n - i)) + ' '.join(str(j) for j in range(i + 1))
        rows.append(row)
    
    # Generate the lower half of the handkerchief (excluding the center row)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        row = ' ' * (2 * (n - i)) + ' '.join(str(j) for j in range(i + 1))
        rows.append(row)
    
    return '\n'.join(rows)
